source_claims.claim: Independent Gamma(alpha_i, beta) variables give the joint Gamma product law.
The normalized vector Y_i = X_i / V has the Dirichlet law.
The Dirichlet vector lies on the nonnegative unit-sum simplex with probability one.
The simplex support has zero ambient volume, making the full law singular.
The projected normalization map is justified by a COV preimage integral identity.
The first n-1 coordinates have the lower-dimensional Dirichlet density in equation (1.4).
When n = 2, the first normalized Gamma coordinate has the Beta(alpha_1, alpha_2) law.
